boundary: This registry describes SCRIMED's locally implemented, synthetic/no-PHI platform foundations and evidence paths. It does not authorize PHI, autonomous clinical care, diagnosis, treatment, prescribing, payer submission, EHR writeback, medical-device connectivity, production deployment, certification claims, customer activation, investor outreach, valuation claims, or revenue guarantees.
investorUse: Internal diligence preparation only; founder, finance, legal, and recipient-specific approval remain required for external distribution.

moatRegistry.name: Governance and evidence runtime
moatRegistry.basis: Policy-before-action, exact evidence binding, independent review, audit receipts, rollback, and release gates.
moatRegistry.compoundingMechanism: Each reviewed workflow contributes reusable policy, benchmark, failure, and approval evidence.
moatRegistry.replicationFriction: Requires integrated product, security, clinical, data, reviewer, and release controls rather than a prompt layer.
moatRegistry.blockedClaim: Does not prove certification, regulatory approval, customer adoption, or production safety.

moatRegistry.name: Healthcare semantics and provenance
moatRegistry.basis: FHIR, HL7, DICOM metadata, payer-policy, ontology, citation, and source-lineage contracts.
moatRegistry.compoundingMechanism: Validated mappings and source contracts improve retrieval, verification, and implementation reuse.
moatRegistry.replicationFriction: Depends on clinical semantics, tenant isolation, transformation lineage, and workflow-specific acceptance tests.
moatRegistry.blockedClaim: Does not prove live EHR integration, medical-device interoperability, or standards certification.

moatRegistry.name: Workflow outcome learning
moatRegistry.basis: Case evidence, accepted outcomes, corrections, worst-cell evaluation, reviewer burden, and value telemetry.
moatRegistry.compoundingMechanism: Reviewed failures become regression cases and workflow improvements without online clinical self-modification.
moatRegistry.replicationFriction: Requires longitudinal evidence and operator adoption, not merely access to the same model.
moatRegistry.blockedClaim: Does not establish causality, clinical outcomes, ROI, revenue, or customer traction before formal evidence.

moatRegistry.name: Model and compute portability
moatRegistry.basis: Provider-neutral routing, task qualification, no privacy downgrade, bounded fallback, and effective-cost accounting.
moatRegistry.compoundingMechanism: Per-task evidence improves model eligibility and cost choices while preserving replaceability.
moatRegistry.replicationFriction: Requires workflow-specific evaluation and policy-compatible failover across model and deployment classes.
moatRegistry.blockedClaim: Does not prove provider availability, BAA eligibility, PHI approval, or production-scale performance.

moatRegistry.name: Regulated buyer operating evidence
moatRegistry.basis: Claims-safe offers, intended-use records, review packets, security gates, migration evidence, and controlled pilot operations.
moatRegistry.compoundingMechanism: Approved buyer and pilot evidence can shorten later diligence only when permission and scope remain current.
moatRegistry.replicationFriction: Requires trustworthy execution history with named owners and independent review.
moatRegistry.blockedClaim: Does not imply customers, partners, revenue, procurement approval, investment, or commercial deployment.

nextBestAction: Complete one buyer-specific Workflow Intelligence Assessment rehearsal with a baseline, acceptance rubric, reviewer burden, verified-intelligence-yield inputs, healthcare-value-returned inputs, and retained no-go boundary.
